messages:
Linda (CS): Heads-up — we just flagged an onboarding impact for a segment of new tenants. ~12 customers getting 401 on webhook validation during sign-up. Growing support queue and a couple of near-term renewals at risk. Need customer update + outreach plan. Can Eng confirm root cause and ETA?
ops-bot: deploy-rollback: rollback initiated at 2026-03-21T14:12:00Z for service webhook-validator by @tom-eng.
Tom (Eng): Root cause: stricter header validation from yesterday's deploy rejected webhook signatures when requests were proxied through certain CDNs. Rolled back successfully. Hotfix in PR, running staging tests; progressive deploy in ~2 hours. Suggest copy: "We rolled back and are restoring normal webhook onboarding. A small number of clients saw intermittent authentication failures."
Maria (CS): Need CSV of affected tenants + tiers. Plan segmentation: 1) Enterprise: personal outreach + credit, 2) Growth/SMB: templated email + FAQ. Flag renewals <60 days.
Kevin (Support): I have 7 matching tickets. For enterprise we'll open dedicated support sessions. Recommend SLA credit if onboarding blocked >24h.
Jess (Onboarding): I'll host office hours today and tomorrow for affected customers. Slots: 2026-03-21 17:00 PT, 2026-03-22 09:00 PT. Will prep a one-page checklist and workspace invite.
Linda (CS): Draft customer note to personalize by tier:

"Hi <CustomerName> — we're sorry for the onboarding interruption. We detected authentication failures for some webhook registrations after a recent deploy. We rolled back the change and are restoring normal operations. Engineers will deploy a fix in a progressive rollout; we'll follow up when your tenant is validated. If this impacted onboarding, we're offering a one-time service credit and a prioritized assist session. Office hours sign-up: <link>. Reply here for a 1:1 walkthrough. — Linda & Redwood CS"

Linda (CS): Add account-specific CSM contact for enterprise.
Maria (CS): Add renewal-reassurance blurb for enterprise: "We recognize onboarding disruptions are unacceptable. We'll provide a detailed RCA and a credit where appropriate. Your CSM <Name> will follow up."
Tom (Eng): Timeline: hotfix tested in staging. Progressive rollout starts 2026-03-21T16:45Z, complete by 2026-03-21T17:30Z if no regressions. Monitoring enabled. Fallback: per-tenant toggle to relax header validation until stable.
Kevin (Support): I'll attach ticket threads to the tenant CSV and draft KB: "If webhook returns 401 during onboarding" with a one-click revalidate flow.
Jess (Onboarding): Will collect feedback during office hours: two quick Qs — 1) Impact to go-live? 2) Was remediation helpful? Store responses in onboarding dashboard.
Linda (CS): Action items: Maria — segmentation + templates (30m). Tom — confirm rollout + monitoring (30m). Kevin — ticket threads + KB draft (45m). Jess — office-hours + enablement doc (1h). I'll coordinate exec comms for renewals flagged high-risk. Sheet: <sheet link>.
Maria (CS): Also include suggested credit amounts by tier for finance pre-approval: SMB $50, Growth $250, Enterprise case-by-case.
Tom (Eng): Posting progress in #eng-runtime and here.
Tom (Eng): Rollout started 2026-03-21T16:46Z; early metrics show handshake success restored for ~60% of affected tenants.
Maria (CS): CSV and segmented templates delivered.
Kevin (Support): Tickets updated with rollback note and credit placeholders. CSMs CCed on outreach.
Jess (Onboarding): Office-hours invites sent, sign-up link included in templates, checklist attached.
Tom (Eng): Rollout completed 2026-03-21T17:29Z; error rate back to normal. Final RCA draft to follow in ~2 business days.
Linda (CS): Great work. Capture lessons in onboarding playbook and paste follow-ups into the sheet. Closing thread after outreach batch completes. :sparkles:
